set.name: DBCI
set.longname: Extended Play — Death Battle Champions Island

card.name: Kamen Rider Geats
card.text: Geats gets +1/+0 for each nonland permanent you control. At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. Put it into your hand if it's an Equipment or Aura. Otherwise, you may play it until end of turn.

card.name: Meta Knight
card.text: Flying, vigilance Exalted (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.) Whenever an opponent attacks, they lose X life, where X is the number of attacking creatures minus 1.

card.name: Flowey, Ruthless Guide
card.text: Reach Whenever another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Flowey. Pay 2 life, Remove two +1/+1 counters from Flowey: Draw a card. Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

card.name: Samus Aran
card.text: Trample Whenever Samus attacks, she explores. (Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.) Whenever a land or artifact you control enters, Samus deals 1 damage to each opponent.

card.name: John Constantine
card.text: Ward—{2}, Pay 4 life At the beginning of your upkeep, draw two cards, then you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost. At the beginning of each other player's upkeep, they may cast a spell from their hand without paying its mana cost.

card.name: Steve
card.text: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, create a tapped colorless land token named Everywhere that is every basic land type. Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card. Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Whenever you cast a battle spell, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.

card.name: Sakuya Izayoi
card.text: Flash This spell can't be countered. The first spell you cast each turn can't be countered. Whenever you cast a spell, if it isn't your main phase, draw a card. Each player loses 1 life.

card.name: Frieren, Spell Collector
card.text: When Frieren enters, create a legendary artifact token named Frieren's Grimoires with "{T}: Exile target instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy. Activate only as a sorcery." Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying until end of turn.

card.name: Hatsune Miku
card.text: Whenever you cast a spell from your hand targeting Miku, copy it, then exile the spell you cast with a song counter on it. Whenever Miku attacks, copy each card you own in exile with a song counter on it. You may cast any number of those cards. (You still pay their costs.)

card.name: Henry Stickmin
card.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, tap target creature an opponent controls. Whenever Henry Stickmin deals combat damage to a player, mill three cards, then put a card from among them into your hand.

card.name: Ash Williams
card.text: Whenever Ash enters or attacks, repeat the following process once if you lost life this turn, once if you discarded a card this turn, and once if you sacrificed a permanent this turn. An opponent of your choice may have Ash deal 3 damage to them. If that player doesn't, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.

card.name: Springtrap, William Afton
card.text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they lose 3 life unless they discard a card or sacrifice a creature. Then, they return up to one creature card with mana value 3 or less from their graveyard to the battlefield with a soul counter on it. It's a 1/1 Spirit artifact creature. Whenever Springtrap attacks, gain control of target creature with a soul counter on it.

card.name: The Slender Man
card.text: Menace When The Slender Man enters, destroy target creature an opponent controls with mana value X or less. Whenever another creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

card.name: Pac-Man
card.text: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Pac-Man. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls. {1}{W}, Discard a card: Pac-Man gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap him.

card.name: Shantae, Half-Genie Hero
card.text: Haste Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.) {1}: Choose another target permanent. Shantae has all activated and triggered abilities of the last chosen permanent.

card.name: Spider-Man
card.text: Flash Backup 1 (When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. If that's another creature, it gains the following abilities until end of turn.) {1}: Return this creature to its owner's hand. {1}: This creature gains flying until end of turn. {1}: Untap this creature.
